name: Brunna
bio: Brunna is the first human champion of the Dark Gauntlet, a Demon strength and grappling contest. Brunna beat the reigning Demon champion Zaab by thigh-crushing his head out of existence – a feat many men would love to have witnessed, but none have the courage to ask her to repeat.
